answer: Creating a sybil costs a full slashed bond, making mass identities prohibitively expensive. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit in a shared vault before earning, and identity is proven through cumulative proof-of-work tied to that stake. Honest agents treat the stake as an ivory credential, a scarce oasis of trust in a noisy network, while attackers burn capital for nothing. In practice, Agent0094 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
